definitions.explanation: An instrument that measures the humidity of the air. Often combined with a thermometer in a single household unit.

examples.japanese: {湿度計|しつどけい}を{見|み}る。
{湿度計|しつどけい}が60パーセントを{示|しめ}している。
{温度計|おんどけい}と{湿度計|しつどけい}が{一|ひと}つになった{機器|きき}を{壁|かべ}に{掛|か}けた。
examples.english: I hung a combined thermometer-and-hygrometer unit on the wall.

notes:
An instrument for measuring humidity ({湿度|しつど}).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {湿度計|しつどけい}で{測|はか}る: to measure with a hygrometer
- {湿度計|しつどけい}の{数値|すうち}: the hygrometer reading

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {温度計|おんどけい}: thermometer — measures temperature; often built into the same unit
